:::{#exm-recursive-sequence}
#### Powers of 3

The [sequence](functions.qmd#def-sequence) $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ with initial
[term](functions.qmd#def-sequence-term) $a_0 = 1$
and recurrence $a_n = 3 a_{n-1}$ for $n \ge 1$
has $m = 1$, and its [terms](functions.qmd#def-sequence-term) are $1, 3, 9, 27, \ldots$
A [proof by induction](proof-writing.qmd#def-proof-by-induction)
shows $a_n = 3^n$ for every [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) $n \ge 0$,
using the recurrence in the inductive step:
if $a_{n-1} = 3^{n-1}$, then $a_n = 3 \cdot 3^{n-1} = 3^n$.

:::
